svg.text: Plot terrain: elevation map with east-west and north-south sections
projects/my-house | plot frame: origin NW corner, field-east to the right, field-north up, metres | colour = ground height (m), 0.5 m bands
South boundary (2 m shared pedestrian passage)
East–west sections A, B, C (field-west/road left, field-east right) — 1:1, no vertical exaggeration; horizontal position aligned with the map
u = distance toward field-east from NW corner (m)
A–A′ (v = 3 m): 1677.39 → 1665.22 m, fall 12.17 m over 32.57 m = 37.4 % toward field-east
B–B′ (v = 9 m): 1677.44 → 1665.57 m, fall 11.87 m over 32.57 m = 36.4 % toward field-east
C–C′ (v = 15 m): 1677.55 → 1665.70 m, fall 11.84 m over 32.57 m = 36.4 % toward field-east
North–south sections D, E, F — 1:1, no vertical exaggeration
v = distance toward field-south from north boundary (m)
Fall summary (least-squares plane over 9635 in-parcel TIN samples, 0.25 m grid)
Plane: z = 1676.43 − 0.3550·u − 0.1593·v (u, v in m; RMS residual 0.21 m)
Average E–W grade: 35.5 % falling toward field-east (sections A–C mean 36.7 %)
Average N–S grade: 15.9 % falling toward field-south (sections D–F mean 15.0 %)
Steepest fall: 38.9 % toward 24.2° from field-east toward field-south = true bearing 92°
(about due east, if the owner-supplied CRS is confirmed)
Contours run at 114.2° in the frame; the west (road) edge runs at 118.7°, so the road follows the contour line
and NW and SW stand at nearly the same height. The N–S fall along a fixed-u line is mostly the main
downhill slope seen obliquely: field axes follow the north boundary, not the slope.
N–S fall is stronger near the road (D 17.3 %) than downhill (F 13.4 %): the ground is not a perfect plane.
Total relief in parcel: 12.71 m (1677.60 m near u = -10.1, v = 18.4; 1664.88 m near u = 32.5, v = 0.0)
Corner heights (TIN): NW 1677.58, SW 1677.60, SE 1665.69*, NE 1664.90
* SE corner lies in a 0.16 m² sliver outside the TIN; value taken at the nearest TIN point, 0.18 m away.
Spot heights: 17 of 27 inside the parcel; 5 off-parcel shown hollow; 5 beyond the map edge not drawn.
Heights interpolated from 27 surveyed spot heights (TIN); vertical datum and CRS unconfirmed; EXPLORATORY, 24 Oct 2026.
